description: The Ace to Five of Pentacles in tarot: upright and reversed meanings for opportunity, balance, teamwork, security and hardship, as prompts for reflection.
lede: The Ace to Five of Pentacles trace the practical side of life from a first opportunity through balance, craft and security to a time of scarcity.

faces.alt: Five original gold-linework tarot card faces in a row, Ace to Five of Pentacles in order. Each shows its number and a pentacle icon, with the card name beneath. There are no scenes or published artwork.
faces.caption: The first five Pentacles move from a seed of opportunity to a lean patch. Use them to ask what needs grounding in your own life.
